summary: Medalist Diversified, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting under Items 8.01 and 9.01 that its Board of Directors authorized and declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0675 per share on the common stock. The dividend is payable October 23, 2026 to holders of record as of October 16, 2026. No advisor was named and no board recommendation beyond declaration was disclosed. This is a routine capital-return declaration, not a special situation; no structural, regulatory, or overhang elements apply. No risk-arb angle exists.
